title: Transport of ringed-topos and module data across a fixed geometric square
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J),(\mathcal D,K),(\mathcal C^{\prime},J^{\prime}),(\mathcal D^{\prime},K^{\prime})$ be small sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $A,B$ be commutative ring sheaves on the first two sites and let $f$ be a ringed-topos morphism from $(J,A)$ to $(K,B)$ [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism]. Fix equivalences $G:\operatorname{Sh}(J)\simeq\operatorname{Sh}(J^{\prime})$, $E:\operatorname{Sh}(K)\simeq\operatorname{Sh}(K^{\prime})$, an adjunction $H:\operatorname{Sh}(K^{\prime})\rightleftarrows\operatorname{Sh}(J^{\prime}):R$ with $H$ preserving finite limits, and a natural isomorphism $\alpha:E^{-1}\mathbin{\cdot}f^{-1}\cong H\mathbin{\cdot}G^{-1}$, using diagram-order composition. There exist commutative ring sheaves $A^{\prime},B^{\prime}$ and ringed-topos morphisms $g:(J,A)\to(J^{\prime},A^{\prime})$, $e:(K,B)\to(K^{\prime},B^{\prime})$, $h:(J^{\prime},A^{\prime})\to(K^{\prime},B^{\prime})$ with $g_*=G_*$, $e_*=E_*$, $h_*=R$, isomorphisms $a:|A^{\prime}|\cong g_*|A|$, $b:|B^{\prime}|\cong e_*|B|$, and $\beta:e^{-1}\mathbin{\cdot}f^{-1}\cong h^{-1}\mathbin{\cdot}g^{-1}$. Their structural maps satisfy $g^\sharp=g^{-1}(a)\,;\,\epsilon_g(A)$, $e^\sharp=e^{-1}(b)\,;\,\epsilon_e(B)$ and $f^{-1}(e^\sharp)\,;\,f^\sharp=\beta_{B^{\prime}}\,;\,g^{-1}(h^\sharp)\,;\,g^\sharp$. Each morphism includes its additive induced direct-image functor on module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], its underlying-sheaf comparison and the adjunction scalar-action identity of the ringed-topos interface. No sites, generators or continuity assertions are constructed here.

proof.text: Apply the single-ring equivalence transport separately to A along G and B along E. This constructs the two vertical ring data with their specified direct images, canonical counit maps and underlying comparisons.

Use full faithfulness of G.inverse and the invertible left structural map to construct the bottom ring data from the fixed natural isomorphism. Its direct image is R and its structural-map square commutes.

Apply the compatible induced-module construction to the two vertical and bottom ring data. Assemble each pair of records into RingedToposMorphism; all geometric and ring fields remain definitionally the ones already constructed. Supply the transported comparisons, fixed natural isomorphism and square equation.

proof_origin.place: Complete assembly from explicit single-ring transport, faithful lifting of the square, and the compatible module direct image construction.

theorem ringedTopos_squareTransport
    {C D C' D' : Type u}
    [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D] [SmallCategory C'] [SmallCategory D']
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {J' : GrothendieckTopology C'} {K' : GrothendieckTopology D'}
    (A : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (B : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{u})
    (f : RingedToposMorphism
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj A)
      ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj B))
    (G : Sheaf J (Type u) ≌ Sheaf J' (Type u))
    (E : Sheaf K (Type u) ≌ Sheaf K' (Type u))
    (H : Sheaf K' (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf J' (Type u))
    (R : Sheaf J' (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf K' (Type u))
    (adjH : H ⊣ R) (hH : PreservesFiniteLimits H)
    (α : E.inverse ⋙ f.inverse ≅ H ⋙ G.inverse) :
    ∃ (A' : Sheaf J' CommRingCat.{u}) (B' : Sheaf K' CommRingCat.{u})
      (g : RingedToposMorphism
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj A)
        ((sheafCompose J' (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj A'))
      (e : RingedToposMorphism
        ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj B)
        ((sheafCompose K' (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj B'))
      (h : RingedToposMorphism
        ((sheafCompose J' (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj A')
        ((sheafCompose K' (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj B'))
      (a : (sheafCompose J' (forget CommRingCat)).obj A' ≅
        g.direct.obj ((sheafCompose J (forget CommRingCat)).obj A))
      (b : (sheafCompose K' (forget CommRingCat)).obj B' ≅
        e.direct.obj ((sheafCompose K (forget CommRingCat)).obj B))
      (alpha : e.inverse ⋙ f.inverse ≅ h.inverse ⋙ g.inverse),
      g.direct = G.functor ∧ e.direct = E.functor ∧ h.direct = R ∧
      g.ringMap = g.inverse.map a.hom ≫
        g.adj.counit.app ((sheafCompose J (forget CommRingCat)).obj A) ∧
      e.ringMap = e.inverse.map b.hom ≫
        e.adj.counit.app ((sheafCompose K (forget CommRingCat)).obj B) ∧
      f.inverse.map e.ringMap ≫ f.ringMap =
        alpha.hom.app ((sheafCompose K' (forget CommRingCat)).obj B') ≫
          g.inverse.map h.ringMap ≫ g.ringMap
